summary: SessionSnapshot.storyPointsField resolution and Jira editmeta call semantics are unspecified for castVote, revealVotes, selectOverrideScore, and resetRound (and only partially specified for withdrawVote). Because all 6 handlers return SessionSnapshot (which requires storyPointsField: StoryPointsFieldInfo | null), omitting whether they call jira.getEditableStoryPointsField(issueId) creates guesswork between QA and DEV on both snapshot.storyPointsField values and JiraClient mock call counts, and returning null on revealVotes/selectOverrideScore/castVote/resetRound would clobber Story Points field detection in the UI right when revealed actions need it (R10, R11, R13). Specify that all 6 SessionSnapshot-returning handlers resolve storyPointsField via jira.getEditableStoryPointsField(issueId) after context, payload, invalid-state, and precondition-failed guards pass (so rejected calls make zero Jira requests), and explicitly state in castVote/withdrawVote that a stored voter record counts as active only when !isRoundExpired(vote.votedAt, nowMs).

Clarify two boundary details in sanitizeLogMetadata so BVA unit tests cannot hit off-by-one or prototype mismatches: (1) use the strict prototype plain-object check (proto === Object.prototype || proto === null, matching src/domain/jira-fields.ts) rather than only !Array.isArray(metadata) so Date/Error/Map/Set passed as top-level metadata deterministically throw validation-error, and (2) anchor the depth counter explicitly (e.g., root metadata is depth 0, nested plain objects and arrays at depth 1..4 are recursively sanitized element/property-wise, and nested plain objects/arrays at depth > 4 are replaced with '[TRUNCATED]').
